cartridge_path.description: Cartridges directory, absolute or relative to the worktree root. Defaults to cartridges/ or source/cartridges/, whichever exists.

config.description: Path to a dw.json, absolute or relative to the worktree root. Defaults to the one the b2c CLI finds next to the cartridges.

binary.description: Path to the sfcc-dap adapter. Set it when it is not on the PATH Zed inherits.

logs.description: Follow the sandbox log with `sfcc-upload logger` while attached, printing it in the debug console.

log_level.description: Log levels followed in the debug console, comma separated, or "all".

client_id.description: Client ID reported to the script debugger API. Change it when two people debug the same instance.

raw_variables.description: Show every member the engine reports, including the ones normally filtered out.
